title: Run
description: A run as a client sees it (ADR-0018): its state and how far its event log has come. Not the job record the harness keeps.

status.description: The run's state. A suspended run names the approval it waits for in its wake condition.

last_seq.description: The sequence number of the run's last event when this was read; 0 before the first. A stream opened with this as its Last-Event-ID receives only later events.
